milestone.title: Agent shell env: PATH snippet install + doctor check for harness terminals

intent.outcome: After install, each supported harness has a documented or auto-deployed env hook so agent terminals can run mp without full paths. mp doctor reports harness-specific env status and remediation.

problem.description: make install and mp install print a PATH/MP_HOME snippet for ~/.zshrc, but IDE agent shells (Cursor, OpenCode) often do not source login shell rc files. Observed in review: mp not found until ~/.agents/master-plan/bin/mp was invoked by full path; MP_HOME unset. mp doctor checks embedded assets and skill files but not whether the current process can resolve mp. M65 fixes binary deployment and adds doctor discoverability warnings; this milestone addresses the harness-side gap: giving agents a reliable, install-managed way to get mp on PATH without manual per-user shell debugging.

in_scope: mp install writes a small env snippet file under ~/.agents/master-plan/env.sh (MP_HOME + PATH export) — idempotent, safe to source
Document in INSTALL.md and master-planner skill: agent sessions should source env.sh or add MP_HOME/bin to PATH (Cursor: note in skill compatibility section)
mp doctor: check whether mp resolves in current PATH; if not, print env.sh path and one-line source instruction

Cursor harness: optionally write ~/.cursor/mp-env.sh symlink or copy snippet path into install cursor convention (if harness registry supports env artifact type — extend registry or document manual step)
Integration test: doctor returns discoverability ok:false when PATH stripped, ok:true when MP_HOME/bin prepended
out_of_scope: Auto-editing ~/.zshrc or ~/.cursor/cli-config.json without explicit user flag
Bundling raul into agent PATH (agents need mp only; humans need raul — M65)

open_questions.question: Should mp install --cursor also copy a Cursor rule snippet referencing env.sh, or docs-only?
open_questions.answer: Suggestion: docs-only in M69; optional --cursor rule deploy as M69 follow-up track item if dogfooding shows agents still miss env.sh after skill update.
